entityDescription: Specto Photonics is an Italian deep-tech start-up aiming to democratize access to Brillouin Spectroscopy by developing and commercializing high-rejection Rayleigh common-path optical filters and miniaturized spectrometers for Brillouin spectroscopy using Silicon Photonics and more. Brillouin Spectroscopy allows the optical measurement of a material's mechanical properties (e.g. stiffness and viscosity) in a non-destructive manner, at high optical resolution and without physical contact. Specto's flagship product, ALBA, will provide significant advantages over current technologies in terms of ease of use, portability, production costs, and performance. The Rayleigh high-rejection filter, BIPD, supports the existing Brillouin setups to eliminate the unwanted and overwhelming Rayleigh backscattering, significantly improving the signal-to-noise ratio, permitting the application of the technique to turbid media like milk and bones. This filter boasts impressive optical rejection capabilities exceeding 45dB. Its first demonstrator has already been fabricated in-house, and the first product prototype is under fabrication. This side product is being developed modularly, allowing it to be utilized independently of ALBA. These competitive advantages will provide unprecedented capabilities for the life sciences, chemistry, and material science sectors and, eventually, medical diagnostics.

tec4U GmbH (tec4U) was founded in 1999. In 2003, the company was awarded the "Gründer Champions" prize at the German Founder and Entrepreneur Days. This was followed in 2010 by the "IT Innovation Award" in the "Saarland State Winner" category at CeBIT for the "CoChecker" software. The company's business activities are geared towards the international market. Quality management is certified in accordance with DIN EN ISO 9001. In October 2013, tec4U GmbH was split into two divisions: tec4U-Ingenieurgesellschaft mbH and tec4U-Solutions GmbH, with the former offering software solutions in the fields of freight forwarding management and automotive. One focus of tec4U is the development of telemetry and telematics systems based on their experience in the field of vehicle dynamics analysis and Car2x communication. 
The company operates based on many years of engineering know-how and the broadest possible database in combination with the possibilities of BIG Data Analytics. The main business goal is to provide customers with all necessary information about their driving units in such a way that they can determine the most cost-efficient combination of vehicle, route and driving specifications for the job on hand – in a comprehensible and reproducible manner. Based on the successful application of the in-house telemetry system "Entruck" for several logistics companies throughout Europe, tec4U has obtained a significant vehicle database that is unique in the field of transport logistics in terms of data resolution, quality and variety. "Entruck” enables manufacturer-independent, standardized, and permanent monitoring of safety and maintenance-relevant vehicle parameters. Using secure data transmission available throughout Europe, over fifty different vehicle parameters can be collected, processed, and reported back to the truck operator in real time, without loss and in high data resolution. tec4U’s consultancy services are based on this data set and provide support in the fields of driving efficiency assessment and emissions analysis. The project team consists of engineers, software developers and business associates with many years of experience in the field of transportation logistics, as well as in the administration of subsidized measures.

entityDescription:
The satellite market is booming, with projections of over 60,000 orbiting objects by 2030. However, strong sustainability challenges arise as satellites have a short lifespan, resulting in overcrowded orbits and $1 trillion worth of value loss due to inoperative assets. In-Orbit Services (IOS) like refueling, repairing, and life extension are proven to be the solution for the expanding satellite population. However, current IOS prototypes face hurdles due to limited autonomy and tailored mission focus, resulting in a lack of scalability and economic inefficiency. A shift towards multi-mission capabilities is crucial to forming a self-sustained space ecosystem, enabling cost reductions and wider market access.

SPAICE pioneered leveraging Generative AI and Deep Reinforcement Learning to develop the first fully autonomous solution to enable In-Orbit Services at scale. Our proprietary software tools enable autonomous navigation and multitasking robotic services and integrate with existing satellites to improve their capabilities. Our software is delivered through a plug-and-play servicing platform including sensors, robot arms, and a computing unit. As a modular payload, our platform is ready to be integrated into any existing satellite, transforming it into a functional in-orbit servicer. Spaice is the first universal AI-based solution for space services, agnostic to any target satellite and capable of performing several robotic operations.

Our primary clients are satellite manufacturers, as our focus involves integrating our robotic platform with their satellite buses to convert them into servicers. We sell them our robotic kit and software charged as a one-time license. These servicers will be used to provide services to constellation operators, for which we will charge a periodic fee. Providers of IOS missions represent an additional sales stream. These companies currently perform in-orbit rendezvous and docking demonstrations with individual targets and aim to scale their services to multiple missions. Our multitask kit is the perfect solution to enable their scalability.

This APO, concerning prevention, protection and assistance organization against technological and major natural risks (Agreement EUR-OPA on Major Risks) has passed the Resolution (87) 2 from the 2ndof March 1987, in which European Community Commission and the UNESCO, the Health World Organization and the Humanitary Affairs Department from the United Nations took part.
On May 17th, 1994, a Convention was signed in-between ECGS and the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, defining the following tasks for which the ECGS will be supported:
- To promote programs in Geodynamics Research, related to the study of Tectonics Distortions in connection with Earthquakes,with a particular emphasize on Space Techniques.
- To improve the relationship between specialists from different scientific disciplines by supporting regular meetings as part of the Journées Luxembourgeoises de Géodynamique (JLG), and also by encouraging colloquia and workshops.
- To equip the Underground Geodynamics Laboratory in Walferdange with the necessary scientific and technical equipment for the study of deformation in a tectonically active zone, in order to test its performance in an aseismic site.
- To undertake these specific actions in a scientific interest.
The Grand Duchy of Luxembourgprovides annual support to:
- Cover the cost of the permanent staff
- Organize the Journées Luxembourgeoises de Geodynamique (JLG)
- Colloquia and workshops related to geodynamics and seismology
- Support will also be provided to cover the cost of publishing the “Cahiers de l’ECGS” and
- the cost of the maintenance and equipment of the Walferdange Geodynamic Laboratory.

entityDescription:
One of Canada’s oldest and most prestigious universities, St. Francis Xavier is consistently ranked the best undergraduate university in Canada.
The first university in Canada to have a formal Service Learning program, StFX values community development, social justice and global awareness. They are home to the internationally-recognized Coady International Institute, and students find leadership development opportunities here that they can apply in all aspects of their lives. Students who are committed to and embody these values thrive at StFX.
Their close-knit residence environment is at the heart of the StFX experience. Students live and learn together in a thriving academic environment. They have a wide variety of fascinating programs to choose from in the faculties of Arts, Science and Education, and within the Gerald Schwartz School of Business.
Their 45,000 worldwide alumni are a strong and engaged community, and provide a valuable network for graduating students.
At StFX, they are excited about where they are, and where they're headed. Today StFX is one of Canada’s very best universities; known for their exceptional academic programs, focus on leadership development and commitment to social justice and community development.
Founded in 1853, St. Francis Xavier has a long and proud tradition as one of Canada’s oldest universities. For almost 165 years, they have cultivated our strong and resilient spirit, dedication to intellectual rigour, and commitment to engaging students who aspire to be community-minded citizens of the world. Their motto Quaecumque Sunt Vera, or “Whatsoever Things are True” perfectly captures our values of integrity, dignity, truth, and respect for all.

Piql Iberia was born in Barcelona in 2016 by a group of Information Management professionals to help organizations better manage their information, whether anological or digital, through a coherent and innovative use of information technologies, adapting them to the reality of each user. With a presence in Barcelona, Madrid and Lisbon itself, the adoption of digital technology has been promoted in various fields, both public and private and in sectors such as Public Administration, Culture, Energy, Engineering or Education, among others.

This vision led Piql Iberia to initiate several projects of development of its own tools, integration of open source software and representation of third-party technologies that allow to cover the entire life cycle of the information, from its creation to the moment that it has to be saved to ensure future accessibility. 

These tools include file management, advanced document management, publishing, digital preservation and digitization solutions. The development of tools based on artificial intelligence techniques for improving information gathering processes or for the most accurate exploitation of available information has been one of the lines of work since the company's inception and have already been used in real projects successfully.

Finally, as part of information management projects, digitization, information capture, archival description and consulting services have been designed to help the faster and easier adoption of digital technologies.

As an important part of this project, an agreement was reached with the Norwegian company Piql AS for the exclusive representation of its digital preservation solutions, an agreement that remains in force and through which projects have been carried out in various public and private institutions.

ISPTech is a spin-off from the German Aerospace Center's (DLR's) Institute of Space Propulsion. We offer efficient, reliable and affordable thrusters and propulsion systems for spacecraft based on so-called green propellants.

As result of more than 10 years of research and development work at the German Aerospace Centre (DLR), ISPTech commercialises the developed propulsion technologies that operate with green (non-toxic) propellants. 
ISPTech’s spacecraft propulsion systems are characterized by a high efficiency, reliability and allow cost reductions up to a factor of 10 compared to conventional systems. The cost reductions are made possible by the use of green propellants, which offer significant advantages in terms of operationally simplicity, safety and handling. In addition, significantly shorter delivery times and cost benefits result from the production of the components using additive manufacturing, the simplified testing of the propulsion system and the use of standard components.
